==English==
{{wp}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɛksˈt͡ʃeɪnd͡ʒ/|[ɛkˈst͡ʃeɪnd͡ʒ]|/ɪksˈt͡ʃeɪnd͡ʒ/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-exchange.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪndʒ|s=2}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|eschaunge}}, borrowed from {{der|en|xno|eschaunge}}, from {{der|en|fro|eschange}} (whence modern {{cog|fr|échange}}), from the verb {{m|fro|eschanger}}, from {{der|en|la-vul|*excambiō|*excambiāre}} (from {{der|en|la|ex}} with {{der|en|la-lat|cambiō}}). Spelling later changed on the basis of {{m|en|ex-}}, with pronunciation following. {{surf|en|ex-|change}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{senseid|en|act of trading}}An act of exchanging or trading.
#: {{syn|en|trade}}
#: {{usex|en|All in all, it was an even '''exchange'''.}}
#: {{usex|en|an '''exchange''' of cattle for grain}}
#: {{usex|en|I'll help you out this time, depending on what can you give me in '''exchange'''.}}
# A place for conducting [[trading]].
#: {{usex|en|The stock '''exchange''' is open for trading.}}
#: {{usex|en|The old corn '''exchange''' has been converted into a music venue.}}
# {{lb|en|telephony}} {{ellipsis of|en|telephone exchange}}.
## {{lb|en|telephony}} A central office.
## {{lb|en|telephony}} The portion of a telephone number that represents (or formerly represented) a central office.
##: {{usex|en|The 555 '''exchange''' is reserved for use by the phone company, which is why it's often used in films.}}
##: {{usex|en|NPA-NXX-1234 is standard format, where NPA is the area code and NXX is the '''exchange'''.}}
# A [[conversation]].
#: {{usex|en|After a lengthy '''exchange''' with the manager, we were no wiser.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|date=27 November 2014|author=Ian Black|url=http://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/nov/27/-sp-courts-jordan-crush-support-isis|title=Courts kept busy as Jordan works to crush support for Isis|passage='Why bother with the daily grind when you can go to Mosul, get paid $400 a month, get a wife – and live an Islamic way,' went an '''exchange''' between two men overheard by a fellow passenger in a taxi. Rumour has it that a woman whose husband died fighting with Isis now receives a generous widow's pension from jihadi coffers.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261013064441/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/nov/27/-sp-courts-jordan-crush-support-isis|archivedate=13 October 2026}}
#* {{RQ:WaPo|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/10/25/king-charles-rishi-sunak-prime-minister/|title=King Charles III plays role his mother did in U.K. power transition|date=2022-10-25|author=Karla Adam|text=The monarch and the prime minister meet weekly, currently on Wednesdays, to discuss matters of state. There is no one else in the room, and many former prime ministers have spoken about how much they have enjoyed the weekly '''exchanges'''.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230329104947/https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/10/25/king-charles-rishi-sunak-prime-minister/|archivedate=29 March 2023}}
# {{lb|en|chess}} The [[loss]] of one [[piece]] and associated [[capture]] of another.
## {{lb|en|usually with "the"}} The loss of a [[minor piece]] (typically a [[bishop]] or [[knight]]) and associated capture of the more advantageous [[rook]].
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} The thing given or received in return; especially, a publication exchanged for another.
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Much Ado About Nothing|2|1|passage= Lady, as you are mine, I am yours, I giue away my selfe for you, and doat vpon the '''exchange'''.}}
# {{lb|en|biochemistry}} The transfer of substances or elements like gas, amino-acids, ions etc. sometimes through a surface like a membrane.
# {{lb|en|finance}} The difference between the [[value]]s of [[money]] in different places.
# {{lb|en|law|E&W|NI}} {{clipping of|en|exchange of contracts}}.

===Etymology 2===
From {{inh|en|enm|eschaungen}}, from {{der|en|xno|eschaungier}}, {{der|en|fro|eschanger}}, from the {{der|en|fro|-}} verb {{m|fro|eschangier}}, {{m|fro|eschanger}} (whence modern {{cog|fr|échanger}}), from {{der|en|la-vul|*excambiō|*excambiāre}} (from {{der|en|la|ex}} with {{der|en|la-lat|cambiō}}). Gradually displaced native {{cog|ang|wrixlan}}, {{m|ang|wixlan||to change, exchange, reciprocate}} and its descendants, {{m|en|wrixle}} being one of them.

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[trade]] or [[barter]].
#: {{ux|en|I'll gladly '''exchange''' my place for yours.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|figurative}} To [[mutually]] [[direct]] at each other.
#: {{ux|en|The opposing soldiers '''exchanged''' fire across the burning streets.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[replace]] with, as a substitute.
#: {{ux|en|I'd like to '''exchange''' this shirt for one in a larger size.}}
#: {{ux|en|Since his arrest, the mob boss has '''exchanged''' a mansion for a jail cell.}}
# {{lb|en|law|E&W|NI}} {{clipping of|en|exchange contracts}}.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[recommend]] and get [[recommendation]]s.
#: {{syn|en|trade}}
